data.headline: Full-stack development for real-time energy dashboards
data.summary: They build full-stack dashboards for grid operators using TypeScript, React, Java and Spring Boot. They also troubleshoot data imports, configure monitoring, write tests, review code and gather feedback from operators.

signals.rendering: They build full-stack dashboards that show grid operators electricity consumption in real time.
They use TypeScript and React for front-end development.
They use Java and Spring Boot for back-end development.
They found the cause of meter data import failures and wrote a parser supporting two supplier CSV date formats.
They configured a Grafana alert to notify the team when meter data imports failed.
They work with a UX designer and observe grid operators using the screens to gather feedback.
They review code for other developers on their team.
They use PostgreSQL and Docker in their development work.
They deploy applications to Azure using GitHub Actions.
They write tests for their work, including the meter data import service.
They build software used by grid operators to monitor electricity consumption.

roles: Full-stack developer in energy or climate tech
